race.title: 'Anyone Want A Drink? Anyone?' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: KAMILLE AU KANADA may well be headed for better things so a 4-timer looks likely. Last-time-out winners Norman Fletcher and Tune In A Box are the likely dangers off unchanged marks. KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR) NORMAN FLETCHER TUNE IN A BOX (IRE)
